message:
docs(history): the +3 was update_manifest_test, and my 18 was never like-for-like

The verifier decomposed run5 (1730) against run6 (1780) on one baseline and the
+50 lands exactly: directory_retry +23, the new shutdown suite +9,
udp_control_e2e +15, update_manifest +3, remainder zero.

So the +3 I left open was update_manifest_test, and my guess about it -- PASS
lines emitted by a suite before it dies -- was wrong. Those four print no ^PASS
lines at all in either run, so they cannot contribute to a difference.

One correction going the other way: the +3 is attributed to 422196b, but that
commit does not touch update_manifest. It changed five files, none of them these.
The only commit in 76897cf..53d4f66 that touches update_manifest.cpp or its test
is 47a63b9, "embed the operational public key". The substance is right and the
commit number is not.

And the bigger lesson is about my own number: 1762 vs 1780 was two different
builds subtracted from each other, so the 18 was never a meaningful quantity.
Decomposing a difference only works once both sides are measuring the same thing
-- checking that comes first.

Measured while confirming: update_manifest_test yields 85 checks on the shared
vectors and 86 on the release-key fixture. Which directory it ran against is part
of the number.
